_about.note: jobs: which font pages it appears on (title, text, notes). tier: C common, R rare, F funky. scale: multiply the sample size by this so wide fonts fit (measured against Bebas Neue / Inter / Caveat, damped). Use line-height >= 1.2 with any scale below 1. Each font file is stored inline as base64 in `woff2` (one file instead of 65, to keep the skill's file count low).
